# Nova

Use `nova/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "nova-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "nova/nova-2-lite-v1",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `NOVA_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.nova.amazon.com/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `NOVA_BASE_URL`.
